Four steps to matriculation

The system walks every applicant through the same sequence, in this order, without exception.

STEP 01

Create Account

Register with a valid email and phone number to generate your unique applicant ID.

STEP 02

Complete Bio-data

Enter personal, guardian, and prior-school details required for your student file.

STEP 03

Upload Documents

Submit O'Level results, birth certificate, LGA letter, and passport photograph.

STEP 04

Pay & Confirm

Settle the acceptance fee online and receive your matriculation number instantly.

Built around the registrar's desk

Every feature exists because a paper process used to require it.

✓

Document Verification

Uploaded credentials are checked against format and size rules before submission, cutting down rejected applications.

₦

Integrated Fee Payment

Acceptance and registration fees are paid through a secure gateway, with receipts issued immediately.

#

Instant Matric Number

On successful payment, the system assigns and emails a matriculation number tied to your department.

◷

Status Tracking

Applicants can log in at any time to see whether their file is pending, under review, or approved.

⇄

Course Registration

Once admitted, students register semester courses directly, with clashes flagged automatically.

⌂

Admin Dashboard

The registry staff review, approve, or query applications from a single administrative panel.
